annotations.title: Risk check for a list of funds

description: Risk Officer: for 1 to 20 fund tickers, the observations to check before the funds are read one by one. Per fund: net assets, fee, top-10 weight, premium or discount to NAV (median, 95th percentile, days over 1%), bid-ask spread, IQ Liquidity Score, leverage (stated multiple and the gap to it over the window), and whether the fund is closed or no longer updated. For the list: the overlap between every pair ETFIQ publishes, the largest fund, issuer and category shares, a leveraged share. Pass weights ({"SPY": 60, "QQQ": 40}, percent) for weighted shares; omit for equal. Each flag names its number, date and the line it crossed (lines); none is advice. A number not published for a fund is listed under that fund, never read as zero.

weights.description: Optional ticker to percent, for weighted shares.

name: etf_risk_check
